2014_spells.entangle.description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting form a point within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain. A creature in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a strength saving throw or be restrained by the entangling plants until the spell ends. A creature restrained by the plants can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself. When the spell ends, the conjured plants wilt away.
2014_spells.entangle.effectSummary: Make a target restrained until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.entangle.fullDescription: Using 1 action, grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot square starting form a point within range. For the duration, these plants turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain; A creature restrained by the plants can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save spell save DC. A creature in the area when you cast the spell must succeed on a Strength saving throw; roll a d20, add the STR modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or be restrained by the entangling plants until the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
